cue_types.transition_slow: slow whoosh, for slower transitions (400 ms or longer, or into calm beats)
cue_types.transition_fast: fast whoosh, for quick scene swaps
cue_types.attention: a random fast whoosh on a visual change that has no other sound, to keep attention up
cue_types.hero_enter: soft pop or click, only for hero cards and giant numbers
cue_types.ui_click: a small UI click for chips, toggles and highlights changing state
cue_types.typing: keyboard or UI typing (comment fields, terminals), trimmed to the typing duration
cue_types.hook_hit: impact with a whoosh, for the hook's set piece
